name: Pitch Deck Structure
description: Produces a pitch deck outline with the 10-12 slide sequence for a business pitch, specific content required on each slide, and validation criteria for each claim. Use when the user asks to create a pitch deck, structure an investor presentation, or plan slides for a funding round or business pitch. Do NOT use for general presentation structure (use slide-deck-structure), executive summary slides (use executive-summary-slide), or business plan writing (use business-plan).
